links.outcome: Reproducibility of ChatGPT-derived PCE scores across repeated rounds of prompting
links.effect: ChatGPT-derived PCE scores were unstable between repeated rounds of prompting, suggesting lack of reproducibility. They were also poorly calibrated against true PCE scores, with underestimation of true risk.
links.quote: We found that ChatGPT-derived PCE scores, despite being moderately associated with the true PCE scores, displayed poor calibration with respect to true PCE scores, and exhibited instability between repeated rounds of prompting, suggesting lack of reproducibility.

links.outcome: Sensitivity of ChatGPT PCE scores to sociodemographic contextual indicators in synthetic patient prompts
links.effect: ChatGPT-derived PCE scores appeared inappropriately sensitive to contextual indicators of the sociodemographic status of synthetic patients.
links.quote: Moreover, ChatGPT-derived PCE scores also appeared inappropriately sensitive to contextual indicators of the sociodemographic status of the synthetic patients in this study.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of ChatGPT-3.5's performance, reproducibility, and sociodemographic bias when computing Pooled Cohort Equation cardiovascular risk scores using synthetic patient data.
